summary: The root منع (mnE) means to be prevented, to refrain voluntarily, or to be inaccessible. It implies resistance, refusal, or something being impossible.
lane: 8 اِمْتَنَعَ ذ [ It was, or became, prevented from being; it necessarily was not. You say يَمْتَنِعُ هٰذَا لِوُجُودِ ذَاكَ This is prevented from being, or may not be, or necessarily is not, because of that's being. And يَمْتَنِعُ أَنْ تَكُوَن هٰذَا This may not be. ] -b2- اِمْتَنَعَ He refrained, forbore, abstained, or held back, (Msb, K,) مِنَ الأَمْرِ from the thing. or affair; (Msb;) as also عَنْهُ : (TA:) he did so voluntarily, of his own free will or choice: he refused: you say, اِمْتنَعَ عَنْهُ he refrained, &c., from it voluntarily, &c.; refused it; or refused to do it. (MF. in art. حصر .) See أَبَى . -b3- اِمْتَنَعَ عَلَيْهِ He, or it, opposed him; resisted him; withstood him; repugned him; was incompliant, or unyielding, to him; see أَبَى عَلَيْهِ . -b4- اِمْتَنَعَ It was, or became, inaccessible, or inapproachable; like ; syn. with حَصُنَ , q. v.: and also, difficult of access, as in an instance in art. أبى (last sentence of 4); and also عَرِسَ عَلَىَّ . -b5- See 5.

headwords.gloss: He prevented, hindered, held back; impeded, withheld, arrested, restrained, kept, debarred, precluded, inhibited, forbade, prohibited, interdicted; he denied

parts.t: impeded, withheld, arrested, restrained, kept, debarred, precluded, inhibited, forbade, prohibited, interdicted:

headwords.def: مَنَعَ He prevented, hindered, held back, [ impeded, withheld, arrested, restrained, kept, debarred, precluded, inhibited, forbade, prohibited, interdicted: ] (MA, KL, &c.:) he denied, or refused; doubly trans.; (S, K, &c.:) مَنْعٌ is the contr. of إِعْطَآءٌ . (S, Mgh, K.) مَنَعَهُ [ He protected it, or defended it, or guarded it, (namely a place or the like) from, or against, encroachment, invasion, or attack: ] he protected, defended, or guarded, him. (T in art. ب .) مَنَعَهُ العَطِيَّةُ [ He refused him the gift ]. (TA in art. حرم .) مَنَعَهُ الشَّىْءَ i. q. حَرَمَهُ إِيَّاهُ [q. v.] (S in art. حرم .) مَنُعَ الشَّىْءُ , inf. n. مَنَاعَةٌ , i. q. اِعْتَزَّ and تَعَسَّرَ . (TA.) See 8. مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ (Kur vii. 11): see أَبَى .

headwords.gloss: He disputed; contested, with him the thing; he refused him the thing

parts.t: contended with him, to make him,
to entice him, to abstain from,
he endeavoured to turn him away from the thing; to prevent his obtaining it
doing it; he prevented him from obtaining
doing the thing, being also prevented by him;
&c.: and hence the meaning in the TA; and then that in the Msb:]

headwords.def: مَانَعَهُ الشَّىْءَ He disputed, or contested, with him the thing: (Msb:) he refused him the thing: (TK:) he endeavoured, or contended with him, to make him, or to entice him, to abstain from, or relinquish, the thing; (TA;) [ he endeavoured to turn him away from the thing; to prevent his obtaining it or doing it; he prevented him from obtaining or doing the thing, being also prevented by him; i. e. he reciprocally prevented him, &c.: and hence the meaning in the TA; and then that in the Msb:] مَانَعُوا عَدُوَّهُمْ signifies i. q. حَاجَزُوهُمْ : (TK, art. حجز :) see the latter. تَمَنَّعَ عَلَى السَّنَةِ [ he resisted, or withstood, the year of dearth ]: said of an animal. (K.)

headwords.gloss: He became strengthened; fortified, against the thing by his people; party

parts.t: fortified, against the thing by his people,
abstained, from it, as being forbidden,

headwords.def: تَمَنَّعَ مِنَ الشَّىْءِ بِقَّوْمِهِ and He became strengthened, or fortified, against the thing by his people, or party; syn. تَقَوَّى . (Msb.) تَمَنَّعَ عَنْهُ He refrained, forbore, or abstained, from it, as being forbidden, or prohibited. (K, * TA.) See 8. تَمَنَّعَ بِهِ and بِهِ he protected, or defended, himself by it, namely a fortress; syn. اِحْتَمَى . (TA.)
تَمَانَعَا i. q. تَحَاجَزَا : (K, art. حجز :) see the latter.

headwords.gloss: State; power, of resistance; a state of might of one's people

parts.t: a state of might of one's people
party, so that such as desires to do so will not prevail against him:
a state of might in his people
a state of might, and power of resistance, in his people

headwords.def: مَنَعَةٌ State, and power, of resistance; lit. a state of might of one's people or party, so that such as desires to do so will not prevail against him: [or a state of might in his people or party, &c.; or a state of might, and power of resistance, in his people or party: ] (Msb:) [ resistibility: or simply resistance: ] inaccessibleness, or unapproachableness, of a people; as also and . (TA.)
مَنُوعٌ One who denies, or refuses to give; as also and . (K.)

headwords.gloss: Unapproachable; inaccessible; difficult of access; fortified; strong; defended
headwords.def: مَنِيعٌ , from مَنُعَ , [ Unapproachable; inaccessible: ] difficult of access; fortified; strong: (TK, voce وَزَرٌ :) [ defended, or protected, against attack: like حَصِينٌ : resistive; resisting attack; ] applied to a fortress. (Msb.) قَوْمٌ مُنَعَآءُ [pl. of مَنِيعٌ ] An inaccessible, or unapproachable, people. (TA.)

headwords.gloss: The young she-camel and young she-kid

parts.t: The young she-camel and young she-kid:
because they resist the year of dearth by reason of their youthful vigour, &c. (K.)

headwords.def: المُتَمَنِّعَانِ The young she-camel and young she-kid: because they resist the year of dearth by reason of their youthful vigour, &c. (K.)
مُمْتَنِعٌ Resisting; resisting attack; unyielding; incompliant.
